tips: | Very hard lane for Cassio due to her shroud, has very strong spikes and can easily outplay a cassio
| One of the biggest threats in midlane due to his poke. Very important to dodge the E and not give away free Q auto procs. Refillable potion on back recommended.
| Not a very strong champ against Cassio but has heavy pressure until you hit items. Has exceptionally strong pressure levels 1 and 2.
| Generally this matchup is easier, as long as you are landing Q's and avoiding charm, you can generally heavily punish her
| Extremely hard matchup, levels 1-5 are easier if you can avoid her Q. Widdle down slowly with Q poke or ping for jungler to gank. Extremely hard to touch this champ
| Be careful for jungler camp as Annie has a reliable form of cc, after getting components its very easy to punish this champion, especially if going ROA as she has a hard time bursting you.
| Very annoying matchup because of his E, generally after reaching a couple of AP components, can out dps him w conqueror (also easy to land ult when he is in W)
| Very annoying champ due to his poke and his damage scaling late. In lane you can generally abuse him for overstepping by running past his soldiers if he wastes his Q.
| Has a weaker laning phase but has exceptional scaling and range post 6
| Generally a favorable matchup for Cassio as she solid DPS with components. Biggest threat is the Q poke and the CC Galio has to set up ganks

| Very hard matchup before items, Miasma placement is very important, I generally like to place it on top of myself if I see him E'ing on top of me. If you go even in lane and reach ROA, he generally can not 100-0 burst you unless he finds lead.
| Generally the biggest threat is his Q poke and his ulti combo at 6, very easy to land abilities on and punish though.

| This is generally a toplane matchup, heavy skill matchup and whichever laner ever gets a lead first will generally dominate laning phase. Important to predict how he will move with his abilitie, can ult as he Q's to ensure your ult lands.
| Generally Cass favored, but be careful early levels as she is much stronger especially level 1 if she starts her E
| Heavy Cass favored, can punish heavily early as long as you avoid getting hit by the Q's
| Not exceptionally hard in laning phase, but late game with move speed items and tankiness he can be super annoying
| A matchup where you need to win hard early because the moment he has his ult, he is incredibly hard to kill at an even state. Very weak before his ult though.

| Despite having W to absolutely shut down her dashes, very easy for her to outplay you especially with her parry, generally I hold my ult for the entire fight unless she wastes parry trying to avoid getting hit by a Q. Very oppressive to play from behind but very easy to get ahead.

| I find this lane very difficult against skilled gangplank players due to how strong the barrels are and how safely they can play around them and how well he scales into the game. Avoiding barrels or autoing the barrel slightly before it decays to last healthbar so it lands at the exact time it reaches 1hp helps make lane slightly easier

| Cassio favored in laning phase, just play around his W CD, but post laning phase when he gets items he is a major threat when even or ahead. Avoid his Q at all costs as he will silence you and you will become a sitting duck as he beyblades on top of you into ignite and ult.
| Generally a squishier champ and easier to punish in lane, try to trade while in mini gnar form as he will be very tanky while in mega gnar form.
| Generally Cassio favored because of how much stronger she is early, avoid getting poked early by max stack Q's and can usually 1v1 her with components
| One of the easiest matchups toplane, avoid her tentacle pull and the matchup becomes very free

| Be careful level 1 for being Q'd on with max stacks, I generally go miasma level 3 instead of 4 for this, if fighting, try to fight inside of your miasma to help minimize her dashing and help you land your Q's.

| Very easy matchup toplane, very reliant on getting ahead. Has strong level 1 and 2 pressure but his counterstrike does nothing against your E so you can still damage him. Once ahead he can't ever contest you.

| one of the harder matchups top as he has incredibly strong poke and all in potential. Try to avoid being hit by Q and if you see him start to all in you, you can drop your miasma on yourself or use your ultimate to stun him.
| Very much a Cass favored matchup, you have heavy pressure against him level 2-3, can become unplayable if he rushes force of nature first item
| Very annoying champ to face, Q poke is very annoying and he will outscale you, avoid being hit by solo Q's and try to poke with your own or make very quick and brief trades while dodging.
| Cass favored early, can become hard if he gains a lead

| Cass favored, can punish her dashes by using miasma followed up by a Q for a quick trade. Very hard matchup if she gains a lead. Pay attention to which way she faces when she starts her ult because that is the direction she is considered looking at when you cast ult.
| Matchup is a case of whoever gets ahead first, Kled is generally stronger in the early levels but once you get components you can outtrade him as long as you dodge his Q.

| Champ is scary in laning phase, but once you start to get items she can't really burst you as easily. if she uses her W on her, you can try to get your miasma down, if she doesnt dodge it, you will generally win the trade
| Avoid Q's and keep track of jungle, 1v1 you win generally but if her jungler comes then you will perma lose
| Very annoying, avoid being poked with Q and having the E damage jump from minions onto you. Qss as a 2nd item heavily recommended, pay attention to where enemy jungler is.
| Generally Cass favored unless he gets ahead or builds full tank, just dodge his Q's and you beat him
| You are much stronger than him early levels, but be careful of his dmg as soon as he hits 6, keep track of your mana and do not underestimate his wither
Annoying matchup to deal with, dodge axes in the early game and be careful of his all in once he hits level 6.

| Extremely hard matchup to play, I generally like to try and push the wave and roam. Very hard to touch this champ as she has exceptional range with her Q and the slow on her W allows her to get away from lots of sticky 1v1 situations.
| is fairly strong in the early levels, can heavily abuse you with his W leap especially if he has press the attack, if you can avoid letting him W onto him, you can win a majority of trades.
| only threat of this champ is the ability to set up a gank, but you can perma out trade her 90% of the time, try to avoid standing by a wall she can stun you on

| Very hard matchup, has very strong burst and solid poke. Biggest threat is her invisibility inside of her Grass Q because you can not use your E on her. Avoid as much poke as possible and try to catch her when she doesnt have grass element.
| Very easy matchup early on, poke him down early and avoid letting him dash onto you with max fury so he doesnt get the empowered W.
| Can be a very annoying matchup toplane because of his healing, can call for jungler help though because your W prevents him from jumping out of the bush and can make the gank much easier.
| Extremely easy matchup as your W prevents her from using half of her kit, be careful level 1 as she will attempt to make a trade and you will lose it every time.
| Very oppressive in the early levels due to his flamethrower, play around the CD of this spell and dodge his tazer missiles and you can win a majority of the trades

| Easier matchup for Cassio, avoid being pull in early, he has a much stronger early game but once you reach components he has a hard time dealing with you unless he manages to grab you. (Your W can stop his ult as well)
| Very easy matchup, his W does not block your abilities. Just avoid his taunt and letting him pull his sword back through you and you win.
| Generally an easier lane for Cassio, but be cautious of his ability to combo with his ult at level 6
| Very easy matchup, avoid being rooted by his E and you are winning. If he gets ahead he can be hard to deal with but at an even state you can generally shred him.
| Cass favored matchup but can still be hard to deal with the all in potential, avoid being hit by his Q poke and being hit by his E, he wins majority of trades where he lands his E.
| Avoid Q poke in the laning phase, if you can dodge the Q E combo you can heavily punish her. At an even state, you can beat her 1v1 at most points.

| This champ will almost always have lane prio into you due to his strong waveclear with his W. Very hard to match his roams but if you can stay even with him and he doesn't get successful roams off he will have a hard time dealing with you.

| Very easy matchup, his blind doesn't work on your abilities, but it can be very scary early levels if he has ignite, once you have components its a very each matchup if you avoid his shrooms walking through lane.

| Hard matchup to play early game, bone plating is heavily recommended because of her all in pressure she has from her W. Exhaust also recommended, She will be perma shoving waves into your tower, but after components you can start to fight her and win.

| Biggest threat from this champs is in the early levels with his ability to all in with ghost. you can kite him as long as you land your Q's, Miasma is also very helpful for this. If you get ahead the matchup is much easier.
| Biggest threat from twisted fate is the pressure of ganks. Otherwise avoid being poked by his Q and don't be hit by the burst on his red cards.
| Be careful for his Q poke and his all in protentional with flash and E. You can generally get free poke in with your Q's and E's as long as you tether properly.
| Avoid giving away free stacks when he uses his Q, biggest threat is his babycage but you generally have more lane prio and can look to roam in this lane.

| Extremely hard matchup, avoid being poked out by his Q especially and avoid the second half of his E. If he lands his W on you post 6, he will ult you and kill you. if he uses ult on you without cc, you can flash ult him to cancel it.
| Avoid being feared by abilities, if you dodge E as well, you win 90% of the trades against vex
| This matchup is won and lost in the first 10m of laning phase, I like to take ignite and heavily trade starting from level 3, whoever gets ahead first basically wins the laning phase.
| Very oppressive to play against, you will never be in range to trade with this champion, only option is to have a jungler camp him, or try to clear waves and roam

| Very hard matchup, he can very easily dash and dodge your Q's, even when he is extremely behind he can still be incredibly strong and oppressive, sometimes if he pushes the lane under your tower, you can run him down if you manage to get a good Q of and his wind wall is down.

| Much easier matchup than Yasuo, just avoid being hit by his dash. Miasma can prevent him from going back in the middle of his E, even if the time has run out, as long as you are dodging the knockup on his Q3 you can win a majority of times. If Yone uses his ult on you, you can ult behind yourself at the same time and it will stun him letting you W and Q him for an extremely good trade.

| This matchup can be annoying due to how tanky yorick can be and how strong his ghouls are. Avoid being hit by his E, the ghouls can be one shot with auto attacks, or you can poison them and E them early on to one shot them.
With this matchup, the goal is to go even and avoid being poked out of lane.

| If you can't dodge his Q's this matchup is incredibly hard, but he can be caught out extremely easily. If he tries to use his satchel charge to get away, you can place your Miasma on him and his satchel will not actually knock him up
| you generally do not lane against this champ, but you have to be cautious for his EQ combo as your Miasma will not stop this dash
| Very oppressive champ to lane against, avoid being hit by her bubbles.
| Very easy lane, use your E to one shot the plants, it takes 2 E's if they are the ult empowered plants
| Great cc and lockdown + Peel
| Poison works for your poison as well
| Poison works for your poison as well
| Poison works for your poison as well
